description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: A contact subscribed to or unsubscribed from the email the person's system sends. Only the person can approve it. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

id.description: The id of the contact in the system.

reason.description: Why, as the person said it.

subscribed.description: True to subscribe the contact, false to unsubscribe them.

type.description: The type of the record: a contact.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.
